# support (support.origincloudapis.eu)

Guide: <https://docs.origincloud.eu/docs/platform/support-cases/index.html.md>

- **CaseService**: Support cases: an organization's questions and problems, and where each one stands.
- **CaseMessageService**: A case's messages: its conversation between the organization and support, oldest first.

## Types

### Case

A support case: one question or problem, and the conversation about it.

- data source `origincloud_support_case`: one by its name
- data source `origincloud_support_cases`: every one under a parent

Attributes of `origincloud_support_case`:

| Name | Mode | About |
|---|---|---|
| `contact_email` | computed | The email address every notification about the case is sent to, for as long as the case exists: when support replies, and when its state changes. |
| `create_time` | computed | When the case was opened. |
| `creator` | computed | The principal that opened the case, such as `user:<id>` or `service_account:<id>`. |
| `description` | computed | What the case is about, in full. |
| `name` | required | The case's resource name, `organizations/{organization}/cases/{case}`. |
| `project` | computed | The project the case is about, `projects/{project}`, one of the organization's. |
| `state` | computed | Where the case stands. |
| `subject` | computed | A one-line summary. |
| `update_time` | computed | When the case last changed: a message added, or its state changed. |
| `urn` | computed | The case's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use. |

### CaseMessage

One message of a case's conversation.

- data source `origincloud_support_case_message`: one by its name
- data source `origincloud_support_case_messages`: every one under a parent

Attributes of `origincloud_support_case_message`:

| Name | Mode | About |
|---|---|---|
| `author` | computed | The principal that wrote the message, such as `user:<id>` or `service_account:<id>`. |
| `body` | computed | The message's text. |
| `create_time` | computed | When the message was added. |
| `name` | required | The message's resource name, `organizations/{organization}/cases/{case}/messages/{message}`. |

## Other actions

These methods aren't a resource's create, read, update or delete. Where an argument of a resource above sets the same thing (a resource's `protected`, say), change the argument; otherwise the provider doesn't manage the action: run it with the CLI, outside of Terraform, when the user asks for it.

- `CloseCase` (`origin support close-case`): Closes a case: its `state` becomes `CLOSED`, and its contact email is notified.
- `ReopenCase` (`origin support reopen-case`): Opens a resolved or closed case again: its `state` becomes `OPEN`, and its contact email is notified.
